title: Dallas Restaurant Chelsea Corner Is One You Should Definitely Want To Frequent When Visiting The City
htmlContent:
Last week, I was invited to a happy hour event at Chelsea Corner in Uptown, Dallas. Originally opened in 1974, Chelsea Corner is located on McKinney Avenue & Monticello. 

The event was hosted by Blake Hart of Vela Wood Law and Stephanie Assi of Carrington Coleman. In celebration of both being named the new Regional Captains of the Sports Lawyers Associations.

The venue was excellent, and the food was amazing, and during the event, they served drinks and pizza as the invitees were able to network from 4:30-6:30 pm CST. After the event was over, the venue allowed a small group of us to watch the NBA playoff games.

Before I left for the evening, I elected to order a couple of dishes off the Chelsea Corner's menu in their Firecracker Shrimp and bread pudding with ice cream. Two of the items I would recommend if you are able to frequent the venue.

The venue food was so good that my family elected to accompany them to Cinco De Mayo. For happy hour we ordered their Hangover Nachos and drinks. As for dinner we order their The Remedy Burger, a couple Back Yard Burgers, and the Braised Short Rib. It is also a venue that gives great portions of food with every order.

Chelsea Corner is a venue that I will have to visit again, and I wanted to thank Blake Hart of Vela Wood Law and Stephanie Assi of Carrington Coleman. I also want to congratulate them again for being selected as the new Regional Captains of the Sports Lawyers Associations.
